description: MCP server for .NET code analysis with Roslyn
releaseNotes:
v0.4.0 - Advanced Features & Performance Optimization
      - Enhanced project management with dependency analysis and build order
      - Source file list extraction in project info
      - Topological sort for build order computation
      - Startup project identification
      - LRU cache implementation for workspace management
      - Incremental analysis support to avoid recompilation
      - Performance optimizations for large solutions
      - Extended integration tests and E2E testing
